meta.name: Section 7, Shah Alam
assumptions: Paths are walkable ways from OpenStreetMap within 450 m of the centre, simplified into segments of at most 80 m.

Shade is modelled, not surveyed: building shadows from mapped footprints (7 m high when the height is not mapped), the sun position on 15 October at this latitude, and covered walkways. 317 mapped trees are included.
Trips per day are rough estimates from the number of buildings near each home cluster.
Intervention locations are chosen where exposed paths carry the most trips; costs come from the unit-cost bill of materials. Replace both with a real survey and contractor quotes.
